newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BANK OF KOREA OFFERS TO SELL DLRS IN FORWARD TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF KOREA OFFERS TO SELL DLRS IN FORWARD TRADE.

text.p: The Bank of Korea stepped into the interbank market in early Wednesday trading, offering to sell $20 million at 899 won in one-month and another $20 million at 907 won in three-month forward trading, dealers said.
Officials at the central bank were not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said the won opened lower in the day's spot trading against the U.S. dollar when the central bank stepped in to boost the local currency.
The won opened at 894.70 and hit an intraday low of 894.90 in early trading, but the central bank's intervention pushed up the local currency to a high of 894.10.
Dealers said the won was being pressured by the Japanese yen's overnight drop against the dollar in overseas markets.
